title: The Last Recording
logline: On the final mountain train, a radio engineer hears a message from the partner she thought was lost.
synopsis: Lin boards the last train with a damaged recorder. Conductor Chen helps restore playback, revealing that the voice is not a farewell but a set of coordinates pointing beyond the fog.

scriptBlocks.text: Rain needles the empty platform as Lin arrives clutching a battered recorder.
Last train. If you're coming, come now.
The recorder clicks and plays one breath of static.
Inside the swaying carriage, Chen reseats the loose battery contact.
That voice disappeared three years ago.
Don't stop at the tunnel. Look above the fog.
A restrained three-note piano motif enters beneath the rail rhythm.
The train climbs into dawn and a transmitter tower appears above the cloud line.
That station has been dark for years.
Then someone just turned it on.
